# Chief AI — Founder Intelligence OS

> Chief AI focuses on organizational knowledge, business objectives, coordinated reasoning and evidence-backed decision support.

- [Public product definition](https://chief.foundercontrolroom.org/)

Chief AI and PromptOS are separate products. PromptOS focuses on instruction engineering. Founder Control Room independently governs authorized execution. The public site distinguishes existing browser-local planning from capabilities requiring activation and verification. Private workspaces, account data, credentials and customer records are excluded.
